name: Voxelization of Lines and Planes
definition: A method to generate a discrete N-separating and N-minimal representation of a polygon by defining a thickness parameter t based on the surface normal and grid size, incorporating voxels whose centers fall within a slab defined by two parallel planes offset from the surface plane.
summary: Voxelization of Lines and Planes generates topologically correct discrete representations by defining voxel slabs with thickness derived from surface normals, ensuring N-separability and N-minimality.
